signature.name: VTask.mapQ
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {M : Type u_2} -> [Ring R] -> [AddCommGroup M] -> [Module R M] -> (p : Submodule R M) -> {R₂ : Type u_3} -> {M₂ : Type u_4} -> [Ring R₂] -> [AddCommGroup M₂] -> [Module R₂ M₂] -> {τ₁₂ : R →+* R₂} -> (q : Submodule R₂ M₂) -> (f : M →ₛₗ[τ₁₂] M₂) -> (h : p ≤ Submodule.comap f q) -> M ⧸ p →ₛₗ[τ₁₂] M₂ ⧸ q

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.mapQ is a total function; all arguments including the compatibility hypothesis h are genuine mathematical data, not junk-value conventions.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p : Submodule R M) (h : p ≤ Submodule.comap LinearMap.id p), VTask.mapQ p p LinearMap.id h = LinearMap.id

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p : Submodule R M) {R₂ : Type*} {M₂ : Type*} [Ring R₂] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module R₂ M₂] {τ₁₂ : R →+* R₂} {R₃ : Type*} {M₃ : Type*} [Ring R₃] [AddCommGroup M₃] [Module R₃ M₃] {τ₂₃ : R₂ →+* R₃} {τ₁₃ : R →+* R₃} [RingHomCompTriple τ₁₂ τ₂₃ τ₁₃] (p₂ : Submodule R₂ M₂) (p₃ : Submodule R₃ M₃) (f : M →ₛₗ[τ₁₂] M₂) (g : M₂ →ₛₗ[τ₂₃] M₃) (hf : p ≤ Submodule.comap f p₂) (hg : p₂ ≤ Submodule.comap g p₃), VTask.mapQ p p₃ (g.comp f) (hf.trans (Submodule.comap_mono hg)) = (VTask.mapQ p₂ p₃ g hg).comp (VTask.mapQ p p₂ f hf)
